source: 12. Why can the order and position of retrieved evidence inside the context window change model performance? [Intermediate - Context] Long-context models do not necessarily use all positions equally well. Lost in the Middle showed substantial position sensitivity on multi-document QA and key-value retrieval: models in that study were often strongest when relevant information appeared near the beginning or end and weaker when it appeared in the middle. The exact pattern is modeland task-dependent, so it should not be turned into a universal rule such as ’always put the best chunk last.’ The durable lesson is that context packing is part of the model interface. Rank the most important evidence deliberately, group related passages, avoid unnecessary filler, and test permutations on representative tasks. Reordering can also interact with citations, chronological reasoning, and contradictory sources. A model advertising a large context window tells you how many tokens it can accept, not that every token position will contribute equally to answer quality. [8]
zh: 12. 为什么上下文窗口内检索到的证据的顺序和位置会改变模型性能？ [中级 - 上下文] 长上下文模型不一定能同样好地使用所有位置。 Lost in the Middle 在多文档 QA 和键值检索方面表现出显着的位置敏感性：该研究中的模型通常在相关信息出现在开头或结尾附近时最强，而在相关信息出现在中间时则较弱。确切的模式取决于模型和任务，因此不应将其变成通用规则，例如“始终将最好的块放在最后”。持久的教训是上下文打包是模型接口的一部分。故意对最重要的证据进行排名，对相关段落进行分组，避免不必要的填充，并测试代表性任务的排列。重新排序还可能与引文、时间推理和矛盾来源相互作用。广告大上下文窗口的模型告诉您它可以接受多少个令牌，而不是每个令牌位置都会对答案质量做出同等贡献。 [8]
